description:
Solace Health | Multiple Engineering Roles | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | No visa sponsorship offered We're hiring Typescript Engineers (full-stack, backend, and platform) on all our core groups. We're Solace Health. In 4.5 years, we've provided free healthcare advocacy to over 200K patients on Medicare, and just begun opening access to everyone in the US. We exist to make sure nobody in the US has to navigate their healthcare journey alone. We hit Unicorn status after our February Series-C led by IVP, bringing us to $207M raised and a $1B valuation. Compensation and benefits are highly competitive and include equity. Open Roles - Senior Full Stack Engineer ($150k-$200k)
- Senior Backend Engineer ($150k-$200k)
- Staff Software Engineer ($200k-$225k, Fullstack or Backend lean)
- Senior Platform Engineer ($150k-$175k)
- Technical Lead ($200k-$230k, player/coach people managers) Tech Stack
Typescript with ReactJS and NodeJS plus NestJS, PostgreSQL, GCP, SQL, TypeORM, shadcn for our UI Library and GCP. K8s for platform. APPLY HERE
 https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Solace?utm_source=x4QJmBQEg7 If you want to build fast with high autonomy and believe in strong typing as much as we do, we'd love to hear from you!
